title: XdrLogRaider — Defender XDR portal-only telemetry
descriptionMarkdown: Polls 493 read endpoints across 18 in-scope nodoc sub-areas of `security.microsoft.com` apiproxy (the surface Microsoft does NOT publish a public API for) and ingests results into 18 `Defender_<Sub>_CL` workspace tables plus 1 `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` operational table via DCE/DCR Logs Ingestion. Auth via sccauth + XSRF cookie chain (Entra TOTP or Passkey, unattended).

sampleQueries.description: All Defender XDR portal data — last 24h volume by table
sampleQueries.query:
union withsource=Table Defender_*_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize count() by Table

XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

union Defender_*_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize count() by Endpoint, SuccessKind

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required on the workspace.

customs.name: Microsoft Sentinel-enabled workspace
customs.description: Sentinel must be enabled on the destination Log Analytics workspace.

customs.name: Service account for Defender portal sign-in
customs.description: Read-only Entra account that can sign into security.microsoft.com. TOTP or FIDO2 passkey configured.

customs.name: Owner or User Access Administrator on the target resource group
customs.description: Required to create the 3 SAMI role assignments at deploy time. Operators with Contributor only can set deployRoleAssignments=false and grant the roles manually after deploy.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Click Deploy to Azure
instructionSteps.description: Use the Deploy to Azure button in the GitHub README. The wizard prompts for the workspace, service account, auth method, and Function App plan SKU. Defaults to Y1 Linux Consumption (cost-optimal).

instructionSteps.title: 2. Upload secrets to Key Vault
instructionSteps.description: If you skipped the inline credentials, run `az keyvault secret set` for `defender-upn`, `defender-password`, `defender-totp` (or `defender-passkey`), `defender-auth-method` against the deployed Key Vault.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify the deploy
instructionSteps.description: Run `pwsh ./tools/Verify-Deploy.ps1 -ResourceGroup <rg>` — emits a 14-phase markdown report. After the first ConnectorHeartbeat (within 10 min), this card flips to Connected.
